svg.title: Four receipts, four different pieces of evidence
svg.desc: A private record proves the brief was saved. Provider acceptance proves an email job was accepted. Delivery proves a recipient mail server accepted the message. Human attention remains unknown. These are distinct claims, not a guaranteed progression.

g.text: The reviewed brief exists in storage.
The email may still be waiting.
The provider accepted the email job.
Delivery is still a separate question.
The mail server accepted the message.
A person may not have seen it.
We have no evidence for this claim.
